title: ctenitis sieberiana
intro: Ctenitis sieberiana, commonly known as the Sieber's wood fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis sieberiana are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
